description: This file defines the 'DefaultLoanLifecycleStateMachine' class, which manages state transitions for loan objects based on various events and current statuses. It implements a finite state machine for loans, handling transitions like approval, disbursal, repayment, overpayment, write-offs, and transfers, including event notifications and related side-effects.

classes.name: DefaultLoanLifecycleStateMachine
classes.description: Implements the state transition logic for loans, handling various transition cases based on loan events and current states, and notifying external systems of state changes.

methods.name: dryTransition
methods.description: Computes the next potential state of a loan given an event, without applying the transition.

methods.name: transition
methods.description: Performs a state transition on the loan, updating derived fields and possibly changing its status.

methods.name: determineAndTransition
methods.description: Determines if a transition is needed based on current loan status and transaction date, then performs it if necessary.

methods.name: internalTransition
methods.description: Updates the loan's status, fields, and notifies relevant events after confirming a transition.

methods.name: isNotLoanCreation
methods.description: Checks if the current event is not a loan creation event.

methods.name: getNextStatus
methods.description: Calculates the subsequent loan status based on the current status and incoming event.

methods.name: determineTransition
methods.description: Contains core logic for determining the appropriate state transition based on the current status and loan details.

methods.name: LoanStatusTransition
methods.description: Inner record class representing the transition target status, associated event, and whether a transition is needed.
